python3 << 'EOF'
# 1953 data - National defense and related activities (in millions)
data_1953 = [3632, 3501, 3789, 3891, 3746, 4056, 3890, 3519, 3787, 3647, 3540, 3465]

# 1940 data - National defense (in millions)
data_1940 = [132, 129, 143, 159, 154, 153, 177, 200, 219, 287, 376, 473]

total_1953 = sum(data_1953)
total_1940 = sum(data_1940)

print(f"1953 Total: {total_1953}")
print(f"1940 Total: {total_1940}")

# Calculate absolute percent difference
# Formula: |V1 - V2| / ((V1 + V2) / 2) * 100
abs_diff = abs(total_1953 - total_1940)
avg = (total_1953 + total_1940) / 2
percent_diff = (abs_diff / avg) * 100

print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff}")
print(f"Average: {avg}")
print(f"Absolute percent difference: {percent_diff:.2f}%")

# Also calculate regular percent change for reference
pct_change = (abs_diff / total_1940) * 100
print(f"\nPercent change from 1940 to 1953: {pct_change:.2f}%")
EOF
